## Environment Variables (set on Vercel)
- SUPABASE_URL
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
- NEXTAUTH_SECRET (or JWT_SECRET)
- Any API keys your app needs

## Build Steps
1. Create repo with github_create_repo
2. Write package.json, next.config, tailwind.config
3. Write database schema with code_template(template=database)
4. Write API routes with code_template(template=crud/auth)
5. Write middleware with code_template(template=middleware)
6. Write frontend pages with code_write
7. Build check with code_build_check
8. Deploy with code_deploy
9. Set env vars with vercel_set_env_var
```
